Senses.Explanation: The first-principle truth. Tianran Hanshi grades the four standings at his own birthday feast — keeping worldly truth only is commoner dharma, leaving it for another truth is śrāvaka dharma, worldly truth itself being this truth is bodhisattva dharma, and neither, with the mind free to aim, is tathāgata dharma; Feiyin Tongrong answers the gavel-master's opening line at his Tian童 inauguration saying this truth was forged by the very first hammer-blow, Linye Tongqi says of it that it had already been proclaimed in full before the gavel fell, and Zhuanyu Guanheng writes to a patron that the father-son reunion at home is the first joy of the human world, is itself this truth, is itself unsurpassed great nirvana. Shanyi Ruchun calls the very project of observing it a hole dug in empty space and a wound cut in good flesh, Zhangxue Tongzui finds every phrase of street-quarter small talk illumining it while Guanyin comes buying with cash, Yi'an Shanzan tells the assembly it need not be sought elsewhere, Yulin Tongxu stands up at the New Year hall to hold it out in the open and then calls everyone to rise at the meal-drum and recite the Amitāyus Buddha, Lianyue Daozheng reads his enthronement proclamation so that tortoise-lines and horse-charts, dragon-script and phoenix-brilliance each fully display it, and Zhe'an Jingfan, after raising Śākyamuni's promise to disclose it, says it was never once touched — porridge at porridge-time, rice at rice-time — and that it does not deceive.
